name: MeTube
description: Adds a YouTube entry to the Jellyfin menu for the users you choose. Search YouTube, press Add, and your MeTube server downloads the video straight into a Jellyfin library, where it shows up with its title, thumbnail, description and date for offline viewing. MeTube stays on your LAN; Jellyfin's own login protects every request.
overview: Search YouTube inside Jellyfin and add videos to your library through MeTube.

versions.changelog: Fixed: the YouTube menu entry did not appear when another plugin also adds its script to Jellyfin's start page by answering that page itself (GuestPass 0.2.x does this). MeTube now wraps such plugins instead of being skipped by them, and both scripts load. Test connection now reports when no page with the menu entry has been served since startup.

First release, for Jellyfin 12.2. Selected users get a YouTube entry in the Jellyfin menu (web and the Android app). It lets them search YouTube or paste a link, then press Add, and your MeTube server downloads the video straight into a Jellyfin library. Each card shows live progress (Queued, Downloading, Processing) and ends with a Play button once Jellyfin has the video. The library is scanned right after the download finishes. Admins choose who may add videos, the longest allowed video and a daily limit per user. Live streams and premieres are refused. Search needs no YouTube API key. If YouTube changes its search page, MeTube's own yt-dlp search takes over. MeTube stays on your LAN: Jellyfin's login protects every request.
